label: Commercial shared savings - typical ranges
disclaimer: Typical ranges from public surveys and issue briefs, NOT any specific payer's contract. Sharing-term sources are 2011-2014 and payment mix is CY2023; no newer public survey of commercial sharing rates or MSRs was found. Never used as settlement terms: a commercial settlement needs the executed contract's terms.

provider_sharing_rate_range.note: some arrangements reach 65% and 80%; quality-gated shares often below 50%

provider_sharing_rate_mean_survey.unit: mean share of savings to ACO, private contracts

msr_practice.value: often none; otherwise a flat percentage (payer retentions of 2% and 5% observed)

savings_caps_practice.value: generally not found in commercial payer models (2011)

private_contracts_upside_only_share.unit: share of ACO private contracts upside-only (2012-13 survey)

private_contracts_quality_contingent_sha.unit: share of contracts with savings contingent on quality

commercial_payments_lan_3_4.unit: share of commercial payments in LAN categories 3-4, CY2023

commercial_payments_lan_3b_4.unit: share of commercial payments with downside risk (3B-4), CY2023
